name: Solang Valley Paragliding
description: Soar above the stunning Solang Valley with tandem paragliding. Experience breathtaking views of snow-capped peaks and lush green meadows as you glide through the Himalayan skies.

name: Rohtang Pass Snow Trek
description: Trek through the famous Rohtang Pass at 3,978 metres. Walk across glaciers, enjoy snowfall, and witness panoramic views of the Pir Panjal range.

name: Beas River Rafting
description: Navigate the thrilling rapids of the Beas River on an exhilarating white-water rafting adventure through scenic mountain valleys.

name: Old Manali Food Walk
description: Explore the charming lanes of Old Manali and savour local Himachali cuisine, Tibetan momos, and freshly baked treats at cozy mountain cafes.

name: Scuba Diving at Grande Island
description: Dive into the crystal-clear waters off Grande Island to discover vibrant coral reefs, tropical fish, and sunken shipwrecks.

name: Dudhsagar Waterfall Jeep Safari
description: Take a thrilling jeep ride through dense forests and river crossings to reach the majestic four-tiered Dudhsagar Falls.

name: Beach Sunset Yoga
description: Practice yoga on the soft sands of Palolem Beach as the sun sets over the Arabian Sea, guided by experienced instructors.

name: Spice Plantation Tour
description: Walk through aromatic spice gardens and learn about the cultivation of cardamom, pepper, cinnamon, and vanilla in Goa's hinterland.

name: Tea Plantation Walk
description: Stroll through the emerald tea estates of Munnar. Learn the art of tea picking and processing, and sample freshly brewed varieties.

name: Eravikulam National Park Safari
description: Spot the endangered Nilgiri Tahr and other wildlife in the stunning grasslands of Eravikulam National Park at 2,000 metres.

name: Mattupetty Dam Boating
description: Enjoy a serene boat ride on the scenic Mattupetty Dam surrounded by tea gardens and eucalyptus forests with mountain backdrops.

name: Munnar Photography Tour
description: Capture the most photogenic spots of Munnar with a guided photography tour through tea estates, waterfalls, and misty valleys.

name: Ganges White Water Rafting
description: Tackle Grade 3 and 4 rapids on a 16 km stretch of the holy Ganges River, surrounded by forested hills and ancient temples.

name: Bungee Jumping at Mohanchatti
description: Take a leap of faith from India's highest bungee jumping platform at 83 metres, overlooking the stunning river valley.

name: Sunrise Yoga at Parmarth Niketan
description: Join a peaceful sunrise yoga session at one of the world's largest yoga ashrams, followed by meditation on the banks of the Ganges.

name: Evening Ganga Aarti Experience
description: Witness the mesmerizing Ganga Aarti ceremony at Triveni Ghat, where priests perform synchronized fire rituals as chants echo across the river.

name: Nilgiri Mountain Railway Ride
description: Board the UNESCO Heritage toy train and wind through 16 tunnels and 250 bridges, enjoying spectacular views of the Nilgiri Hills.

name: Botanical Garden Exploration
description: Explore the 22-hectare Government Botanical Garden featuring over 1,000 plant species, a fossil tree trunk, and a beautiful fern house.

name: Ooty Lake Boating
description: Row across the picturesque Ooty Lake surrounded by eucalyptus trees and gentle hills. Choose from paddle boats, row boats, or motor boats.

name: Coffee Plantation Experience
description: Walk through lush Coorg coffee estates, learn the bean-to-cup journey, roast your own coffee, and enjoy a fresh brew amid the plantations.

name: Abbey Falls Trek
description: Trek through cardamom and coffee plantations to reach the spectacular Abbey Falls, which cascades down 70 feet amid lush greenery.

name: Namdroling Monastery Visit
description: Visit the largest Tibetan Buddhist settlement in India. Explore the Golden Temple with its 40-foot golden statues and intricate murals.

name: Edakkal Caves Exploration
description: Climb to the prehistoric Edakkal Caves and discover rock engravings dating back to 6,000 BCE, perched atop Ambukuthi Hills.

name: Kuruva Island Bamboo Rafting
description: Float on a bamboo raft through the serene backwaters surrounding Kuruva Island, spotting rare birds and orchids in the riverine forest.

name: Meenmutty Falls Trek
description: Trek through dense tropical forest to reach the three-tiered Meenmutty Falls, the largest waterfall in Wayanad at 300 metres.

name: Cliff-top Sunset Photography
description: Capture stunning sunset photographs from the dramatic Varkala Cliff, where the Arabian Sea meets ancient sedimentary rock formations.

name: Ayurvedic Spa Treatment
description: Indulge in a traditional Kerala Ayurvedic massage and wellness treatment at a cliff-side spa overlooking the ocean.

name: Kodai Lake Cycling
description: Cycle around the scenic star-shaped Kodaikanal Lake, passing through eucalyptus groves and flower gardens on a well-maintained path.

name: Coaker's Walk Sunrise Trek
description: Walk along the stunning Coaker's Walk at sunrise for panoramic views of the Palani Hills and the plains of Tamil Nadu below.

name: Pine Forest Photography Walk
description: Explore the enchanting pine forests of Kodaikanal, famously featured in Indian cinema, and capture magical light filtering through tall pines.

name: Key Monastery Visit
description: Explore the 1,000-year-old Key Monastery perched dramatically on a hilltop at 4,166 metres, home to Tibetan Buddhist monks.

name: Chandratal Lake Trek
description: Trek to the crescent-shaped Chandratal Lake at 4,300 metres, one of the most stunning high-altitude lakes in the Himalayas.

name: Stargazing in Spiti
description: Experience one of the clearest night skies in the world. Observe the Milky Way, constellations, and shooting stars in the pollution-free desert.

name: Amber Fort Elephant Ride
description: Ascend to the magnificent Amber Fort on the back of a decorated elephant, just as the Rajput royals did centuries ago.

name: Old City Food Trail
description: Sample the legendary street food of Jaipur — from pyaaz kachori and dal baati to ghewar and kulfi — in the bustling old city bazaars.

name: Block Printing Workshop
description: Learn the traditional art of Rajasthani block printing. Create your own fabric designs using hand-carved wooden blocks and natural dyes.

name: Coral Reef Snorkelling
description: Snorkel in the turquoise waters of Elephant Beach, Havelock Island, discovering vibrant coral gardens and exotic marine life.

name: Sea Walking Adventure
description: Walk on the ocean floor wearing a special helmet and interact with tropical fish and coral at a depth of 7 metres.

name: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk
description: Witness the magical phenomenon of bioluminescence as the waves glow blue on the shores of Havelock Island on moonless nights.

name: Morning Boat Ride on Ganges
description: Glide along the ancient ghats of Varanasi at dawn, watching the city awaken with morning rituals, cremation ceremonies, and yoga practitioners.

name: Banarasi Silk Weaving Tour
description: Visit the workshops of master weavers and witness the intricate process of creating world-famous Banarasi silk sarees on traditional looms.

name: Street Food Safari
description: Navigate the narrow galis of Varanasi sampling iconic treats — from creamy malaiyo to crispy tamatar chaat and the legendary Banarasi paan.

name: Pangong Lake Day Trip
description: Drive through the world's second-highest motorable pass to reach the mesmerizing Pangong Lake, whose waters change colour throughout the day.

name: Khardung La Pass Ride
description: Ride or drive over Khardung La, one of the world's highest motorable passes at 5,359 metres, for an adrenaline-pumping high-altitude adventure.

name: Thiksey Monastery Morning Prayer
description: Attend the morning prayer ceremony at the stunning Thiksey Monastery, a 12-storey complex resembling the Potala Palace in Lhasa.

name: Sam Sand Dunes Camel Safari
description: Ride a camel across the golden Sam Sand Dunes at sunset, then enjoy a traditional Rajasthani dinner and folk performances under the stars.

name: Jaisalmer Fort Heritage Walk
description: Explore the living Jaisalmer Fort with a knowledgeable guide, discovering hidden temples, ancient havelis, and stories of Rajput valour.

name: Desert Stargazing Night
description: Lie on sand dunes far from city lights and gaze at one of the clearest night skies in India, with expert astronomers pointing out constellations.
